newsitem.title: USA: GE Spacenet unit to acquire Bosch Telecom.
newsitem.headline: GE Spacenet unit to acquire Bosch Telecom.

text.p: GE Capital Spacenet Services Inc said it had agreed to a deal to acquire the satellite communications services unit of Germany's Bosch Telecom GmbH in a bid to expand its pan-European presence.
GE Spacenet is a unit of General Electric Co 's GE Capital Services unit.

The Bosch unit provides Very Small Aperture Terminal (VSAT) satellite communications services to about 2,000 sites. GE Spacenet currently offers or is in the process of building another VSAT systems at another 6,000 sites in Europe.
VSAT satellite systems provide two-way interactive data communications for services such as retail credit card verification.
A spokeswoman said that GE Spacenet supplies the software to operate the VSAT systems. Gilat Satellite Networks Lt supplies hardware for GE Spacenet systems.

In a statement, Gino Picasso, president of GE Spacenet said his company was attracted by Bosch Telecom's existing presence in western and central Europe, its central network facilities, and its installation and maintenance capabilities.
The Bosch deal, which is subject to the approval of the Federal Cartel Office in Germany, was signed on November 14.
Under terms of the deal, GE Capital Spacenet Services - Europe GmbH will continue to operate the Bosch VSAT business at the existing Backnang, Germany facility.
Hughes Network Systems, a unit of Hughes Electronics Corp, is GE Spacenet's principal rival in the European VSAT business.
